goal: Make the 400 PROFILE_SCOPE_INVALID profile-error response events in src/delivery/asgi-core-profile.mjs as deeply immutable as success-path response events. Before this package, profileErrorEvents() froze the events array, each event object, and the headers array, but not the inner header pair tuple ["content-type", "application/json"] itself, so a host adapter could still mutate that one array in place even though every other layer of the event tree was frozen. Success-path response events already froze each header pair individually (toResponseEvents). This package closes that one gap so host adapters receive a consistently, fully immutable event tree on both the success path and the profile-error path.
nonGoals: no new dependency, listener, HTTP/net/fs capability, environment read, clock or randomness use
no change to response status codes, error codes, header names/values, or event shapes
no change to the success-path header-pair freezing behavior, which was already correct

scopeResolution.note: One-line production fix: wrap the inner profile-error header pair in Object.freeze(...) inside profileErrorEvents(), matching the per-pair freezing toResponseEvents() already does for success responses. No other line changed.

red.note: Added assertions to the existing malformed-scope test and a new callFromReceive malformed-receive-event test proving each header pair in the 400 profile-error events[0].headers is frozen. Both failed against the pre-fix source with 'The expression evaluated to a falsy value: assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(pair))', proving the inner header pair tuple was mutable before this package.

green.results: All 35 tests pass, including the new frozen-header-pair assertions for the malformed-scope path and the callFromReceive malformed-receive-event path. npm run check exits with its existing GREEN/historical-snapshot verdicts unchanged; no new failures introduced.

acceptance.profileErrorHeaderPairFrozen: profileErrorEvents()'s events[0].headers[0] tuple is frozen (Object.isFrozen === true), for both the malformed-scope and malformed-receive-event 400 paths
acceptance.successHeaderPairsStillFrozen: success-path response header pairs remain frozen exactly as before (already covered by prior tests)
acceptance.noBehaviorChange: status codes, error codes, header names/values and event counts are byte-identical to before this package

rollback.trigger: the added Object.freeze on the inner header pair is found to break any host adapter expecting a mutable pair, or any existing test regresses
rollback.action: revert the single Object.freeze wrap in profileErrorEvents(), the two added test assertions/test, this planning file and the CHANGELOG entry as one shard
rollback.blastRadius: one array literal inside profileErrorEvents(); no other function or file touched
rollback.runtimeDataImpact: none; no runtime, DB, or I/O surface involved

capabilityDelta: ASGI_PROFILE_ERROR_EVENT_TREE_FULLY_IMMUTABLE: the 400 PROFILE_SCOPE_INVALID profile-error response now has its inner header pair tuple frozen, matching the depth of immutability already present on the success-response path. Host adapters now receive a consistently fully-frozen event tree regardless of which path (success or profile-error) produced it.

userJourney.once: asgi-core-profile.mjs, 400 PROFILE_SCOPE_INVALID hata yanıtı üretirken olay dizisini, olay nesnelerini ve başlık dizisini donduruyordu, ama başlık çiftinin kendisini (['content-type', 'application/json']) dondurmuyordu. Başarılı yanıt yolunda ise her başlık çifti ayrı ayrı donduruluyordu.
userJourney.simdi: profileErrorEvents() artık içteki başlık çiftini de Object.freeze ile donduruyor; böylece 400 hata yanıtı da başarılı yanıt kadar derinlemesine değişmez (immutable) hale geldi.
userJourney.fark: Tek satırlık bir üretim kodu değişikliği: profileErrorEvents() içindeki başlık çifti artık donduruluyor. Durum kodları, hata kodları ve başlık isim/değerleri hiç değişmedi.
userJourney.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir host adaptörü (örn. bir ASGI sunucusu) geçersiz bir scope veya bozuk bir receive olayı aldığında 400 PROFILE_SCOPE_INVALID yanıtını alır; artık bu yanıtın başlık çifti de dahil olmak üzere tüm olay ağacı donmuş durumda, tıpkı başarılı yanıtlarda olduğu gibi. Bu paket bir sunucu/host seçmiyor; sadece mevcut çağrılabilir fonksiyonun değişmezlik tutarlılığını sağlıyor.
userJourney.kalanEngel: Hâlâ gerçek bir HTTP sunucusu/host adaptörü bu callable'ı sarmalamıyor; bu yüzden runnableProduct hâlâ false.
